name: Superspective
description:
About This Game

Pass through a hallway and arrive where you started.

Climb a staircase and watch the wall become the floor.

Leave a cube in one spot and return to it from somewhere else.

Superspective is a first-person puzzle game set in a seamless, non-Euclidean space that is governed by logic, but not the kind you’re used to. Experience firsthand the majesty of impossibility.

There are no tutorials, no dialogue, no signs telling you what to do. Just you, an abstract world, and the quiet sense that something may be observing you.

You can expect to...

  • Explore a seamless, non-Euclidean world where space folds, loops, repeats, and at every turn defies expectation.

  • Discover that gravity is relative; direction is a matter of perspective.

  • Lose yourself in an abstract, surreal environment of clean lines, geometric architecture, and stark visual contrasts.

  • Solve spatial puzzles that reward careful observation and unconventional thinking.
short_desc: Solve mind-bending physics and logic puzzles in Superspective, a first-person puzzle game where gravity is relative, rooms twist and fold back on themselves, and surreal architecture challenges how you think about space. Experience unreality.
